parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

healthyThreshold.description: The number of consecutive health checks successes required before moving the instance to the Healthy state.

interval.description: The approximate interval, in seconds, between health checks of an individual instance.

timeout.description: The amount of time, in seconds, during which no response means a failed health check.

unhealthyThreshold.description: The number of consecutive health check failures required before moving the instance to the Unhealthy state.
